snippet.title: Vortex 9  VR - Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Vortex 9 at https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/vortex-9/30260007240309622/ - coming to Meta on 26th February, 2026

Well, here you are, fans of VR shooting games… Find yourself in a totally strange and Xtremely attractive world of fighting cat-people and speaking robots.

Is it a demon girl attacking you with a big gun? Who is this guy with a box instead of his head and a bat in his paws? No worries! Get your battle lollipop or a shooting gun and show them who’s the boss! Stylish brawlers, insane weapons and explosive shooter battles are here in Vortex 9!

Become the strongest brawler in this 3rd person VR shooter! Choose any hero you like! Maybe a giant spy Mr Goodboy or vicious Hellen D. Mon, or better both? Vortex 9 - shooting games main features:

- 8 amazing characters: John, Jane, Marvin McSpy, Mr Goodboy, Jess Purrfect, Hellen D. Mon, Mercydroid and Beelzebox. Customize your hero from head to toe or choose someone special!
- Weaponry: dozens of crazy shooting guns! Atypical melee weapons, heavy machine guns will make you the strongest in online multiplayer games!
- Little helpers in battle! Create your own pet and let them join a fight!
- Game modes: Team battle, Deathmatch Solo, Capture point - get a gun and join the battle! More online modes are coming!
- Various maps: brawl in a variety of beautiful locations and enjoy marvelous graphics!
- Play with friends: make fights more fun and intense together!

Online multiplayer games have never been so dynamic and exploding! Grab a Space Minigun, jump into the brawl battle! #vortex9
